changelog: 1.1.3 (Jellyfin 12.2 to 12.4): rows were missing for some accounts. An account that had saved its own Home Screen Sections choice never saw the Reco+ rows added to the Home Screen Sections table afterwards (Trending, Popular…): they are now ticked for it once, and stay unticked if it unticks them. The Preview tab says which rows Home Screen Sections does not show to an account. A row with no title from the library (Upcoming, or a current list whose library titles the account has already watched) stayed empty: its titles outside the library are now shown.
